assessments.reasoning: The fixed output-extension function chooses .jsx under preserve for a .tsx input. The output path routine applies the selected extension.

The exact pipeline applies the TypeScript transformation and conditionally installs the JSX transformation. The release utility restricts that gate to transform modes. This context addresses JSX retention. The release-package probe checks retention and the output filename together.

The 5.9.3 package wrote sample.jsx retaining the JSX element in preserve mode. The same text in .ts was rejected with TS2304 and TS1005 and no output. React Native mode retained the element in sample.js, establishing a separate output path.

limitations: The source grammar mode, output file extension and retained element are the assessed facts. An output .jsx file requires its own downstream handling. Other JSX modes and .ts input have separate behavior.
